texts.preamble: Mukesh Verma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thr on 19 January, 2018 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Cra-1252-2017 (Mukesh Verma Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thr) 3 Gwalior, Dated : 19-01-2018 Shri B.K.Sharma, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State. This appeal is though filed under Section 76 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006, however, there is non-compliance of provision contained under sub section 1 of section 76 which contemplates the deposit of the amount imposed by way of penalty or compensation or damage. Mukesh Verma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh Thr on 27 February, 2018 THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH CRA-1252-2017 (MUKESH VERMA Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THR) Gwalior, Dated : 27-02-2018 Parties as before.
